rubrics.justification: The response incorrectly states no Gardner score was available and analyzes a hypothetical Day 4 morula instead of the provided 1DD blastocyst, missing the key morphology of poor ICM and poor TE.
It integrates age, AMH, BMI, PCOS label, sperm factors, endometrium, and cycle history reasonably well, though some conclusions are built on the mistaken assumption of an ungraded Day 4 embryo.

The reasoning is internally structured but has a major foundational inconsistency: it ignores the provided 1DD grade and bases prognosis on an assumed unscored Day 4 morula, weakening the probability estimate and conclusions.

Many recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice, but the failure to use the Gardner grade and some speculative suggestions (e.g., routine DHEA/CoQ10, protocol criticism without full context) reduce alignment.
The response gives clear practical recommendations for transfer support and future cycle planning, though some advice is less tailored because it mischaracterizes the embryo stage/grade.
